messages:
Claire B.: Corvus AI (CV-221) INV-2026-0199 is 49 days overdue. Balance $28,300, no partials. Sent dunning #3 this morning.

Sam R.: Any product holds?

Luis (AM): No service incidents. CFO asked if we can accept a 3-month instalment plan due to VC bridge financing delay. Wants to avoid suspension.

Claire B.: Our policy allows multi-month plans only with 30% upfront and signed guarantee. Propose 30/35/35 over 60 days, first payment due in 10 days to account for wire delays. No fee waivers without manager sign-off.

Sam R.: Sounds fair. If they sign and the first payment posts within 10 days, we hold suspension. Otherwise escalate.

Legal: [auto] Use standard payment-plan template and include clause: "proof of wire initiation required within 5 business days; plan void if payment not received in 10 days."

CollectionsBot: [auto] Dunning #3 sent to ap@corvus.ai (2026-04-22T11:02:10Z). Delivered. Next reminder scheduled 2026-05-02T09:00:00Z.

Luis (AM): I'll send the agreement and CC legal. Will request PO number and director guarantee.

Claire B.: Approve 30/35/35 contingent on signed plan and first payment within 10 days. If not, escalate to legal and prepare suspension notice 48 hours after escalation.

CollectionsBot: [auto] Thread tag set: "payment-plan-offered".
